articles.title: ZDI-26-849: Microsoft Qlib RestrictedUnpickler Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
articles.summary: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Microsoft Qlib. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120315 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: LobeHub Chat from 1.84.26 before 2.1.49 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by supplying unsanitized file names to writeTempFile(). Attackers can create a file record via file.createFile with a traversal name, then trigger document parsing to overwrite application files like startServer.js for code execution or denial of service.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120314 — CVSS 7.3
articles.summary: Network-AI from 5.14.0 before 5.15.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the A2AServer class that allows unauthenticated attackers to access task operations when no secret is configured. Attackers can send JSON-RPC requests to tasks/send, tasks/get, and tasks/cancel without a Bearer token to execute tasks, read results, and cancel tasks.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120313 — CVSS 7.5
articles.summary: Network-AI before 5.15.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in InputSanitizer.sanitizePath() that allows attackers to escape the base directory using sibling-directory paths. Attackers can supply paths whose directory name shares a string prefix with the base, bypassing the unanchored startsWith check to read, list, or write files outside the sandbox.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120312 — CVSS 8.8
articles.summary: Network-AI from 5.13.4 before 5.15.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AgentVCR that allows attackers controlling the cassette name to read or write arbitrary .json files. Attackers can pass traversal sequences to load() or save() to disclose sensitive JSON data or overwrite policy files such as AuthGuardian trust-level configuration.

articles.title: CVE-2026-120311 — CVSS 8.8
